title: Time hierarchy for positive bounds
statement: Let $S$ be a diagonal simulator for $\Phi:\mathbb{N}\times\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Assume $t\le\Phi(t,n)$ for all natural numbers $t,n$, and let $f,g:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ with $g$ time-constructible and $g(n)>0$ for every $n$. Suppose that for every natural number $A$ there is a threshold $N$ such that $A\Phi(f(n),n)\le g(n)$ for all $n\ge N$. Then $\mathrm{DTIME}(f)$ is a proper subset of $\mathrm{DTIME}(g)$.
